This is a confirmed pre-existing, recurring CPU plugin correctness gap (4th recorded occurrence in the pattern database), not a regression introduced by this push.

Confirm no ov::Exception is thrown for indices_values=(0, 100000) axis=0 on IS=[8,4] updates=[2,4] for all f32/i32 x i32/i64 index-precision combinations.
recommended_actions: Add bounds-checking to the ScatterUpdate CPU kernel in src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/scatter_update.cpp so out-of-range indices throw ov::Exception during execution rather than silently reading/writing out of bounds.
